title: FOMC decision (meeting Oct 26-27 2027, no SEP) — the only 2027 meeting this calendar did not yet track
source: EST: federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm, fetched direct 2026-09-06 by this session (HTTP 200, 164,831 bytes, page stamp "Last Update: August 19, 2026"). Its 2027 panel reads verbatim "January 26-27 | March 16-17* | April 27-28 | June 8-9* | July 27-28 | September 14-15* | October 26-27 | December 7-8*", where the same panel's footer defines "* Meeting associated with a Summary of Economic Projections" -- October 26-27 carries NO asterisk, so this is a statement-and-press-conference meeting with no projections and no dot plot. The panel's own footnote block was cut before parsing, because a year-scoped read of it otherwise returns a phantom ninth 2027 meeting from the sentence "Note: A two-day meeting is scheduled for January 25-26, 2028."; cutting each panel at its footer returns exactly 8 meetings in each year 2021-2027. Weekday verified rather than assumed: 2027-10-26 is a Tuesday and 2027-10-27 a Wednesday, the Committee's standard Tuesday-Wednesday shape, and the decision lands on day two. Filed estimate because the same page states verbatim "Each meeting date is tentative until confirmed at the meeting immediately preceding it", so the promotion trigger is the 2027-09-14/15 meeting ratifying October 26-27 -- not a better fetch. The 2:00 p.m. ET statement time is the Board's standing convention and is not stated on this page; federalreserve.gov/newsevents/2027-october.htm, the month page that would carry it, returned 404 to this session. Discovered during the fomc-minutes-2027-10-06 initial research, checked 2026-09-06
notes: PROPOSED by the fomc-minutes-2027-10-06 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-06). THE HOLE IS EXACT AND MECHANICAL: this calendar tracks fomc-2026-09-16, fomc-2026-10-28, fomc-2026-12-09, fomc-2027-01-27, fomc-2027-03-17, fomc-2027-04-28, fomc-2027-06-09, fomc-2027-07-28 and fomc-2027-09-15 -- every scheduled FOMC decision from September 2026 forward EXCEPT this one, which is the last 2027 meeting before December and the immediate downstream neighbour of the release this lane researched. It sits at D+21 from the 2027-10-06 minutes, which is the modal minutes-to-next-decision gap in the record (65 of 156). IMPACT high matches the family: every canonical fomc-<date>.json entry in this calendar is high, and this lane does not re-litigate a sibling class's tier from outside it. THREE NOTES FOR WHOEVER TAKES IT. (1) NO SEP. The October meeting has no asterisk on the Board's own panel, so it publishes no projections -- which makes the 2027-09-14/15 SEP (the first with a 2030 dot, per federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomc_projectionsfaqs.htm: "The projections made in September and December are for the current year, for the subsequent three years, and for the longer run") the standing forecast the Committee is judged against for a further seven weeks, until December 7-8. (2) THIS MEETING IS THE PROMOTION TRIGGER FOR ITS OWN NEIGHBOURS, not just for itself: fomc-minutes-2027-10-06 and the blackout proposed alongside it both inherit the tentative status of the meeting dates they are derived from, and the December meeting inherits this one's. (3) NOTHING TRADEABLE IS CLAIMED HERE. This lane's own measurements are about minutes releases, not decisions, and its conclusions do not transfer: symbols is empty, no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1) is rates-keyed, and a decision day is a different animal from the release the parent studied. Proposed as an estimate; estimate widens caution and licenses no entry.
